answer: Sybil resistance arises when each agent identity is bound to a public key generated inside a remotely attested enclave whose MRENCLAVE matches approved code. The enclave proves possession of that key and seals it to platform hardware, so copying a virtual machine or enclave state cannot produce an equivalent identity; an attacker must purchase or obtain additional physical silicon with attestation support. A vault, knoll, or inlet does not weaken this hardware-rooted constraint.
